new_exact_gates.requirement: A failed receipt is not rehabilitated by an authority request
Revoked evidence remains unusable for a promoted claim
An unobserved revocation state cannot be inferred fresh
A future-issued receipt cannot justify present authority

A reviewer label alone is not signature evidence
A declared signature marker is not verified cryptographic evidence
An approval scope label cannot replace an approval document
A supplied-document flag does not establish affected-party approval
A synthetic affected-party flag does not grant competent authority
